compute_budget.time_budget_scope: Grid/Arrangement/BnB search stages; exact feasibility and bound certificates run to completion and may extend total runtime

rational_lattice_certificate.coordinate_representation: exact fractions in x_m/y_m; x_m_display/y_m_display are presentation-only
rational_lattice_certificate.angle_note: The certified orientation is the exact rational rotation induced by q, which approximates theta_source_deg_display_only; it is not asserted to be mathematically identical to the floating search angle.

lattice_relation_verification.spacing_proof: For distinct integer index pairs, the exact squared separation is m^2*a^2+n^2*b^2 because the certified basis is orthogonal; it is therefore at least min(a,b)^2.
limitations: This certifies membership in the declared rational orthogonal lattice, not CRS correctness or field feasibility.

source_constraint_feasibility_certificat.arithmetic: exact rational arithmetic on canonical decimal inputs; no epsilon in point-in-polygon or squared-distance comparisons
source_constraint_feasibility_certificat.input_interpretation: decimal strings/integers are exact; finite floats are interpreted by their shortest round-trip decimal string
source_constraint_feasibility_certificat.geometry_scope: GeoJSON Polygon/MultiPolygon, including interior rings (holes); MultiPolygon components must be strictly disjoint and non-touching
source_constraint_feasibility_certificat.clearance_policy: required_clearance = declared_clearance + explicitly supplied uncertainty allowance; no uncertainty is inferred
limitations: This certifies feasibility of the finite submitted candidate set relative to the serialized source geometry and declared margins; it does not certify global optimality.
CRS/datum correctness, survey accuracy, source provenance, and whether uncertainty allowances are adequate require separate gates.
MultiPolygon components that touch or cross are rejected rather than normalized.
Input decimal values are treated as exact mathematical values; this is not a claim about physical measurement truth.

certified_upper_bound.arithmetic: exact rational arithmetic over canonical decimal coordinate/spacing values; sqrt bounds use integer arithmetic at 1e-12 m; pi upper bound 355/113
certified_upper_bound.proof_scope: all translations and orientations in the declared Euclidean 2-D lattice family, with lattice centers in the represented valid polygonal usable geometry; not arbitrary point placement
certified_upper_bound.proof_outline: Centered fundamental cells of accepted lattice points are disjoint up to boundaries, each has area at least cell_area_lower_bound, and each lies in the radius-R parallel body of conv(U). Steiner's formula bounds that body's area by A_hull + P_hull*R + pi*R^2. All irrational terms are conservatively enclosed with rational bounds. Therefore N <= floor(area_upper/cell_area_lower).

optimality.scope: all translations and orientations of the declared rectangular lattice family within the decimalized represented usable polygon; conditional on a passing exact-rational lattice relation and usable-geometry feasibility certificate
optimality.not_scope: unrestricted free-point packing; unrepresented physical geometry; uncertain survey truth; other crop spacing profiles

notices: The rational lattice relation, source-constraint feasibility, and represented-usable-geometry feasibility are separate certificates.

An optimality conclusion is issued only when the exact-rational feasible lattice lower bound matches the certified upper bound for the same declared rectangular lattice family and represented usable geometry.
Survey/CRS provenance, uncertainty adequacy, agronomic approval, and field validation are separate gates; deployment remains unauthorized.
